title: Wrapping card row
summary: flex-wrap plus a flex-basis gives responsive rows with no media queries.
explanation: flex: 1 1 160px means "start at 160px, grow to share spare room, shrink if needed". With flex-wrap: wrap, items that cannot fit at their basis move to a new line.
Each line grows independently, so the last line's cards can be wider than the others. If you need equal columns, a grid is the better tool.
tryThis: Drag the preview width and watch the cards reflow.
Change flex to 0 0 160px: no more growing.
